why: The same class as `ui-falso__monorepo`, on the dependency axis: the rule read only `dependencies`/`devDependencies` from the ROOT. Measured, openkartline was accused of "no prettier, biome or dprint" while being a pnpm workspace with `"prettier": "^3.4.2"` in apps/web/package.json and two scripts (`format`, `format:check`) that call it. The root of a monorepo usually declares no dependency at all — it is just the map of the workspaces. Here the raw union of all manifests is the right match, and in `ui-falso` it is not: the package manager hoists the formatter to the whole workspace, so declaring prettier in one package formats the entire repository, while a `components.json` configures the aliases of one project only. The two roots are identical; only the package's manifest changes.
